subject.title: fix(logging): narrow STRUCTURED_APP_PASSWORD_FIELD_RE to Apple/iCloud-specific fields

question: Should generic text/error/message app-password masking require token-local or proximity context before this PR can merge, or may maintainers accept the current whole-field context tradeoff?
rationale: This PR changes the boundary between preserving transcript data and masking possible credentials, and code review can identify the tradeoff but maintainers own the accepted security/data-integrity policy.

options.title: Require token-local context
options.body: Make generic-field app-password masking depend on context near each candidate token and cover a mixed-context regression before merge.

options.title: Accept whole-field context
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept remaining same-field over-masking and the narrower no-context secret coverage as the chosen redaction policy.

options.title: Use another canonical fix
options.body: Pause this PR and route the canonical issue to another open redaction PR if that branch better matches the desired security/data-integrity tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Require token-local context
recommendation.body: Make generic-field app-password masking depend on context near each candidate token and cover a mixed-context regression before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight has recent adjacent redaction work in the same module and is the strongest available routing candidate for this security-sensitive redaction tradeoff after the original feature introducer.
